fields.value: Group an experiment's eval jobs onto one machine with one inference server

Part of the EXP-66 stream, stacked on PR #113 (loopflowstudio/etude#113). After EXP-66's first PR, each eval job with new matches is still launched as its own run, and every game process loads its own model weights.

Outcome: a launch pass gathers the new matches of an experiment's eval jobs into one run per machine, renting for them only when enough are queued; on that machine Etude starts one inference server and every game relays its moves to it. An inference server is its own declared record, `InferenceServer(name=..., serve=..., config=...)`, with batching defined on it and nowhere else, and an `EvalJob` names the server its evals run on.

Jack Heart, 2026-11-14: "you wait until you have enough queued eval jobs ... Then on that machine, you spin up the one inference server as we discussed and then you run all of the queued eval jobs on that inference server"; "the batching protocol has to go with wherever you define the inference server and then experiments need to be able to say, 'Run my evals on this \[inference\] server'"; "I am okay with it currently being limited to sharing within one experiment"; "Just start the inference for server work stacked on top of it".

The accepted design is `scratch/eval-serving.md` in the Task checkout (handed off from EXP-66). No rental: no spend allowance has been given. No release. Its PR is based on PR #113's branch and is not merged or armed. Sharing across experiments is EXP-72; LLM and hosted players are EXP-71.
